planets.name: TOI-7189 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-7189 with a 2.89-day year, found in 2026.

text.card: TOI-7189 b was found in 2026 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-7189. Its orbit and size follow Premnath et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
